claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b094] Scope decisions for this batch (lines 1-117 of results/documentation-audit/verification-2026-04-21.md; lines 118-233 are sibling batch b095). (1) Out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5 and therefore NOT extracted: dates and timestamps; git commit hashes (731466d8, e07dae37, ad023fc3); verification-claim identifiers (C01-C85); Obs identifiers (Obs 267-273); erratum identifiers (E54); version strings (v1, v2); and every line-number citation, including the `<file>:<line>` locators that fill the draft_file and cited_source columns. Applying this removes rows C17, C18, C20, C23, C26, C31, C33, C37, C38, C42 and C43 in their entirety - their only numbers are working-notes line numbers, Obs headings, a commit hash or an erratum id - so no claim row is emitted for them. That omission is a deliberate scope decision, not an oversight. (2) Table handling (rule 6): one claim per table row, values[] in order of appearance. Where the same figure is restated verbatim across the claim_text, cited_value and actual_value columns (the common case in this table) it is emitted ONCE, because all three columns assert the same fact about the same artefact; where the columns differ in precision (`364.6971 -> 364.70`), in scale (`0.91 (91 %)`) or in content (28 cited vs 26 actual) each distinct figure is emitted separately. (3) Buffer radii used purely to identify which row a metric belongs to ('F1 @ 50 m', 'CIs at 20-50 m') are context, not claims; a radius asserted as a run parameter (C44 buffer, C59 parameters.buffer_metres) or as a result (C30 'effect ends at 125 m') IS extracted. Shell bounds (100-125, 125-150) are shell identifiers. (4) DATED SNAPSHOT: this is a verification record fixed at 2026-04-21 and several anchor artefacts have since been regenerated - the document's own post-recovery banner (lines 15-26) says so for the text-high track. Figures are recorded verbatim as at the verification date and are NOT modernised. Per instrument rule 3 the figures the banner explicitly supersedes (text-high cost, F1 @ 50 m and Dawid-Skene F1: rows C09, C10, C11 and the text-high operand of C45) are marked `historical` and the banner's replacement figures are live claims; rows C12 and C44, which the banner lists but does not restate, are kept as live `read` claims carrying an as-at note. (5) Two cited anchors no longer exist at the cited path and are anchored at their archived locations: results/55maps-image-generalisation/human-reviewed-corrected/corrected-f1-human-reviewed.json -> archive/55maps-superseded-gt-evals/per-run/..., and configs/run-configs/55maps_image_generalisation_pre_launch_audit.md -> archive/superseded-audits/configs-.... (6) C27/C28 quote the pre-recovery multi-buffer F1 curve and are anchored to the preserved pre-recovery snapshot summary.json.pre-recovery-20260503T023134.backup rather than the live summary.json, because the backup is the least-writable artefact that held those values at the verification date. (7) Where the anchor is a non-JSON artefact (markdown report, CSV, directory listing) it is kept per instrument v1.1, which blesses non-JSON anchors and routes them to triage rather than resolving them mechanically. anchor.path is null throughout for those; individual values carry a human-readable section-and-row locator in `path` where the figure sits in a nameable table row (rows C41, C65), and null where the claim is a whole-file property such as a byte count, a line count or a directory listing (rows C39, C40, C61, C62), in which case the method is `read` for single-value claims and `recompute-script` where a count must be derived. CLAIM NOTE: this is the 'now' side of the banner's correction block, so all four figures are live claims (rule 3). `tiles_failed: 0` is quoted without a stage qualifier; the proposer stage is the only stage in the text-high cost manifest that carries a tiles_failed counter, hence the path chosen. The 'e.g.' framing means the banner exemplifies rather than enumerates the post-recovery changes. [REPAIR S127] claim_text was truncated mid-line at 'F1 @50m 0.', dropping the 0.7920 and 0.8142 values it carries; span re-copied verbatim from lines 18-20. Values and anchors unchanged.
